item.title: Hot Springs police arrest suspect, identify victim in deadly Monday shooting
item.description: Hot Springs police said they have arrested a suspect in a deadly shooting that happened on Monday afternoon.

item.title: Teenager recovering from injuries after shooting in North Little Rock neighborhood
item.description: North Little Rock Police say a teenager is recovering after being shot Monday night in an alley near the intersection of 21st Street and Pike Avenue.

item.title: UAMS expands doula training program
item.description: UAMS added at least 25 trainees to its doula training program, which is in its second year, with some changes added. According to the trainer of the program, Nicolle Fletcher, the first year of the program only taught students for six months, but the second year would be a year-long training.

item.title: Longtime Little Rock Central High School principal announces retirement
item.description: A longtime educator in the Little Rock School District announced her retirement.

item.title: University of Arkansas at Little Rock unveils new Cyberspace Operations Research and Education center
item.description: Growing just as fast as the need for cybersecurity professionals, the University of Arkansas at Little Rock's cybersecurity program has grown from humble beginnings in 2021 to reserving an entire floor in its Engineering & Information Technology Building dedicated to cybersecurity.

item.title: Previewing Arkansas Sports Hall of Fame 2026 inductees with Steven Riffle | Terrell Talk
item.description: This week, Donna previews the 2026 Arkansas Sports Hall of Fame banquet and inductee class with Executive Director Steven Riffle.

item.title: Little Rock City Board of Directors approves nearly half a million dollar legal settlement
item.description: After a legal battle that began in 2021, Little Rock city leaders approved a resolution to settle with four former LRPD police officers for $450,000.

item.title: Pine Bluff mayor vetoes Urban Renewal resolution, citing financial risk and transparency concerns
item.description: The future of the Pine Bluff Urban Renewal Agency remains uncertain after Mayor Vivian Flowers vetoed a city council resolution supporting the agency. Flowers cited concerns about financial risk, accountability and the accuracy of information provided to council members.

item.title: Arkansas State University athlete on Israel’s first Olympic bobsled team at 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: Menachem Chen’s journey into bobsledding didn't start on ice; it started five years ago with a message, and the person who sent it? AJ Edelman, the pilot of the Israeli bobsledding team.

item.title: Person detained for questioning in Nancy Guthrie search
item.description: Sources tell NewsNation the person was detained south of Tucson.
